q.zh: 32 块蓝积木和 24 块黄积木，分成一模一样的小袋，全部分完。最多能分几袋？这题用哪个？
q.en: 32 blue blocks and 24 yellow blocks go into identical bags, using them all. What is the most bags? Which idea do you use?

why.zh: 往小里分、问「最多几份」，是拆。答案：8 袋。
why.en: Splitting into the most groups means breaking apart. Answer: 8 bags.

q.zh: 1 路车每 15 分钟一班，2 路车每 20 分钟一班，8:00 同时发车。下一次同时发车用哪个？
q.en: Bus 1 every 15 minutes, Bus 2 every 20 minutes, both leave at 8:00. To find the next time together, which idea?

why.zh: 两个节奏「下一次一起」，是凑。答案：9:00。
why.en: "Next time together" means building up. Answer: 9:00.

q.zh: 一块 48 cm × 30 cm 的木板切成同样大的正方形，不浪费。边长最大是多少？用哪个？
q.en: A 48 cm × 30 cm board is cut into equal squares with no waste. Largest side? Which idea?

why.en: "Largest" with no waste means breaking apart. Answer: 6 cm.

q.zh: 12 和 18 的最大公因数是多少？
q.en: What is the GCF of 12 and 18?

q.zh: 4 和 6 的最小公倍数是多少？
q.en: What is the LCM of 4 and 6?

why.zh: 跳 4 和跳 6 的青蛙第一次在 12 相遇。
why.en: The 4-frog and the 6-frog first meet at 12.
